title: Nine-platform XRP research coordination: capability, authentication, permissions and data-flow status

platforms.name: ChatGPT
platforms.evidence: Current ChatGPT runtime used for research and structured GitHub connector operations.
platforms.auth: Managed ChatGPT session; no external provider token exposed.
platforms.default_permission: Public web research and GitHub read/search/branch/PR operations exposed by connected tools; no secret access or merge authority used.
platforms.xrp_role: Orchestration, evidence synthesis, hypothesis comparison, source-quality review.
platforms.adapter_status: Native session tools tested; no claim of independent external agent process.

platforms.name: Codex

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.evidence: deploy_huggingface.py, sync-huggingface.yml and force-deploy-space.yml exist. Main sync workflow is manual with explicit YES and writes a Space plus propagates secrets; force-deploy-space can force-push an external Space without an explicit confirmation input. PR #1480 proposes disabling both.
platforms.auth: HF_TOKEN is referenced through GitHub Actions secrets; no token value read or live authentication test performed.
platforms.default_permission: Read-only model/dataset lookup; external uploads/secrets require protected human approval.
platforms.xrp_role: Designed model/dataset registry, reproducible model artifacts and inference hosting.

platforms.name: Kaggle
platforms.evidence: kaggle-competitions.yml runs daily at 00:00 UTC and passes KAGGLE_USERNAME/KAGGLE_KEY; kaggle_competitions_automation.py defaults to up to five active competitions and submits generated baseline files. Main has no explicit submission approval gate. PR #1480 changes it to manual-only and adds an explicit allow_submission/KAGGLE_ALLOW_SUBMISSIONS guard.
platforms.auth: KAGGLE_USERNAME/KAGGLE_KEY referenced through GitHub Actions secrets; no credential read or account test performed.
platforms.default_permission: Dataset/leaderboard read-only; submission disabled unless separately approved.
platforms.xrp_role: Designed public historical dataset sourcing, benchmark replication and reproducible competitions; no XRP auto-submission.

platforms.name: Databricks
platforms.evidence: mcp_databricks.py uses DATABRICKS_HOST/TOKEN and Jobs API; deploy_databricks.py uploads files with overwrite, creates/updates a scheduled job and triggers it. deploy-databricks and databricks-bundle require manual YES inputs; rotate-databricks-token accepts a token as workflow input, writes a GitHub secret and dispatches deployment. PR #1480 proposes disabling these workflows.
platforms.auth: DATABRICKS_HOST/TOKEN referenced through GitHub Actions secrets; no token read or workspace test performed.
platforms.default_permission: Read-only SQL/feature-store access in a dedicated workspace; no workspace upload, job create/update/run or secret rotation without protected approval.
platforms.xrp_role: Designed historical feature store, large-scale walk-forward/backtesting and reproducible shadow evaluation.

execution_substrate.name: GitHub
execution_substrate.role: Repository, issue/PR, CI and durable handoff substrate; not counted as one of the nine target AI platforms.
execution_substrate.permission_boundary: Changes are prepared on branches and PRs; no merge, force-push or manual workflow dispatch in this run.

repository_adapter_audit.generic_mcp_adapter: barrot_agent/mcp_adapters.py contains generic Git and read-only filesystem adapters; no dedicated authenticated Claude/Grok/Gemini/Codex adapter was verified.
repository_adapter_audit.databricks_and_huggingface: Existing clients are primarily for the Stupid Sindy/video pipeline, not proven XRP research agents.
repository_adapter_audit.groq_vs_grok: scripts/groq_chain.py and Groq API credentials are not xAI Grok. Treat as separate services.

designed_task_assignment.ChatGPT: Orchestrate evidence intake, normalize claims, maintain relationship graph and forecast ledger, synthesize disagreements.
designed_task_assignment.Claude: Independent red-team review, counter-hypotheses, falsification and calibration critique.
designed_task_assignment.Grok: Public social-discourse/event discovery; distinguish sentiment from verified market activity.
designed_task_assignment.Gemini: Multimodal public filings, video and document extraction with page/time provenance.
designed_task_assignment.Codex: Minimal isolated-branch code implementation, tests and reproducible fixes.
designed_task_assignment.HuggingFace: Model/dataset discovery, immutable model artifact registry and inference; no automatic public upload.
designed_task_assignment.Kaggle: Historical dataset/benchmark replication; submissions disabled by default.
designed_task_assignment.Databricks: Historical feature store, point-in-time joins, walk-forward backtesting and shadow evaluation; no workspace deployment without approval.

evidence_envelope_schema.rule: A platform output is a sourced claim until independently corroborated. Preserve minority objections and provenance; do not force consensus.

least_privilege_design.default: Read-only public data and repository reads; separate scoped credential per platform; no shared secrets.
least_privilege_design.write_controls: Human approval and a protected GitHub Environment with required reviewers for repository mutation, deployments, public uploads, Kaggle submissions, token rotation or external job execution.
least_privilege_design.secrets: Never pass raw tokens or private data in prompts, artifacts, logs or cross-platform handoffs.
least_privilege_design.data_flow: Public source -> immutable snapshot -> feature store -> independent agent analyses -> evidence envelope -> contradiction/red-team review -> human-approved code/PR changes.
least_privilege_design.fallback: If provider unavailable/rate-limited, continue deterministic local ingestion and record provider_unavailable; do not silently substitute current data for historical values.
least_privilege_design.disagreement_resolution: Rank source quality and independence; preserve dissent; require explicit counter-evidence before promoting inference to confirmed.

security_findings.main_kaggle_daily_auto_submission: ACTIVE_ON_MAIN_UNTIL_APPROVED_REMEDIATION; daily schedule, secrets, up to five active competitions, script auto-submits.
security_findings.main_force_deploy_space: ACTIVE_ON_MAIN_UNTIL_APPROVED_REMEDIATION; manual workflow can force-push to Hugging Face Space without explicit approval input.
security_findings.main_databricks_token_rotation: ACTIVE_ON_MAIN_UNTIL_APPROVED_REMEDIATION; accepts token as workflow input, writes secret and dispatches deployment.
security_findings.proposed_quarantine: PR #1480 disables/quarantines these paths; remains draft and unmerged. PR #1487 separately disables Merge Queue on fresh main; remains draft and unmerged.

next_actions: Do not claim Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle or Databricks are live XRP collaborators until each adapter passes an explicit auth and least-privilege test.
Design provider adapters with capability manifests and a common evidence envelope before enabling cross-agent data exchange.
Use read-only Databricks SQL/feature-store access and Hugging Face model/dataset read access first; defer deployment/write scopes.
Disable or gate current main's scheduled Kaggle submissions and force-push/secret-rotation workflows through reviewed proposals before any external execution.
Retain independent red-team assignments and minority objections in the durable research ledger.
